markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (74%)** · Confident · Careful review
Single-class conformal set [F1], 25% invasive risk, JPEG degradation, and positive frozen-section margins warrant review.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 74%, Invasive 25%, Benign/Normal 0% | Favors InSitu; 25% invasive risk |
| Conformal set | {InSitu} (90% target; 90% dataset coverage) | Single class at dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 100% OOD (12 tiles, JPEG-3) [F6] | Atypical OOD, unflagged; error AUROC 70% |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Same top class | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 4/5 InSitu (76%–80%); 1 Invasive (77%, BACH_0205) [F5] | 80% neighbor match for InSitu |

## Tissue evidence
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 4, 6, 8) · context · Elevated score (-0.85); context only (8/20 spot check) [F2] · Weak
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 1, 5, 6) · ↓ invasive · Elevated score (-0.46) lowers risk (12/20 spot check) [F3] · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 3, 7, 8) · ↑ invasive · High score (+0.45), 0/20 spot check; unreliable [F4] · Unreliable
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 2, 6, 9) · ↑ invasive · High score (+0.40), 3/20 spot check; unreliable · Unreliable
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 6) · ↑ invasive · Elevated score (+0.37) favors invasion (19/20 spot check) · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Top-3 risk removal drops risk above random (0.011, 95% CI 0.002–0.020); heatmap reflects classifier use.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI spans zero (-0.009 to 0.006, unverified); mitoses (0/20) and necrosis (3/20) are unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- High-risk regions 10, 8, 11, and 7 (69%–87% risk) harbor true invasion like contrast case BACH_0205 (77% similarity).
- Simulated frozen-section and severity-3 JPEG artifacts distort tissue, while stains are blocked and cell segmentation is disabled.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 10, 8, 11, 7**: highest classifier invasive risk (87%, 81%, 71%, 69%); rule out stromal invasion.
2. **Regions 1, 5, 6**: confirm duct confinement; check region 6 for invasion vs unreliable necrosis.
3. **Regions 3, 7, 8**: check positive margins (superior 538 um, inferior/lateral 430 um, medial 323 um) [F7]; ignore unreliable mitoses.
